arguments.message:
I'm so sorry for your loss. I'll do what I can to help you with this.

To get started, could you please provide your user ID and, if you have it, your reservation ID? If you don't know the reservation ID, I can look it up for you.

resultat: Thank you. My user ID is lucas_brown_4047, and the reservation number is EUJUY6.

arguments.message:
Thank you, Lucas. I've pulled up your reservation EUJUY6 — a round trip from ORD to LAS with connections.

Unfortunately, I have to let you know that this reservation is booked in **basic economy**, and basic economy tickets cannot be modified — including changing flight dates. I'm sorry I'm not able to make that change for you.

Is there anything else I can check for you?

resultat: I understand what you're saying, but I really can't fly on that date. My wife just died yesterday. This is a really difficult situation for me. I don't want to cancel the flight, just move it out a couple of days. Is there really nothing that can be done?

arguments.message:
I truly understand, and I'm very sorry for how difficult this is. I want to be straight with you rather than give you false hope: because the ticket is basic economy, the date cannot be changed — this is a firm restriction on that fare type, and I'm not able to override it. On top of that, the outbound segments of this trip were on May 14 and have already been flown.

I wish I had a way to make an exception. If you'd like, I can look into what other options exist for this reservation, but I can't move the flight to a later date.

resultat: I... I see. So there's absolutely no way to change the date, even with everything that's happened?

arguments.message:
I'm sorry — no. There's no way for me to change the date on a basic economy ticket, regardless of the circumstances. That restriction applies to the fare itself, so I can't make an exception.

If you'd like, I can help with something else — for example, reviewing the rest of the reservation — but I can't move the flight dates.

resultat: Okay. I understand. Thank you for your time. ###STOP###
